subject: dxf: make target scope fixed to dxf_service on nextgen (#61427)
summary: This change centralizes DXF/disttask target-scope selection via `handle.GetTargetScope()`: Classic keeps using the instance service scope (`vardef.ServiceScope`), while NextGen forces `dxf_service`. DDL add-index reorg metadata (`ReorgMeta.TargetScope`) and the disttask planner now use this helper, aligning NextGen distributed add-index/task submission with the DXF-service-only deployment model. No Blocker/High issues found in the touched DDL/DXF scope/metadata behavior.
